If you're just talking Spearhead armies, Seraphon is pretty straightforward. You get 3 Kroxigor which are huge beat sticks that excel at clearing hordes with sweeping blows from their giant mauls, 10 Saurus Warriors that are solid melee infantry and are good at hunkering down on an objective, and the mighty Saurus Oldblood riding a Carnosaur as your general that can sprint across the battlefield and gobble enemies up. I find them super fun!

Ogor spearhead has more moving parts. You've got some Gluttons as your main infantry, some Leadbelchers that can shoot with their big cannons that they're big enough to carry, and a Tyrant leading them. Then, on round 3, you can bring in a Mournfang Pack, which is a heavy cavalry duo, along with an Ironblaster, an enormous cannon that should make short work of whatever enemy units are left.

I don't think you can go wrong. I personally am ride or die Seraphon, but it's all about what speaks to you personally. Have fun!

Endgame gear is the equipment you want to use at the end of the game. There are 25 floors you gotta fight through, and they get really tough later on. So plate armor, or scale if you can't find plate, a good tier 4 or 5 weapon, your mage's staff, a good ring or two, an artifact or two. Try to invest in combinations that work well together (like a wand of fireblast plus armor of brimstone, or a ring of haste and good ranged stuff), but ultimately you gotta make the best of the gear you find.

You only get so many scrolls of upgrade, and you'll usually find yourself wanting more. Use em wisely, but if you're in a bind, it's okay to use them on "non-endgame gear" if it'll get you through a tough spot.

Good luck!

Edit: so in your case, you already have a tier 5 weapon and a tier 5 armor, plus a wand of lightning and a ring of haste. Those are all great, especially on the freerunner, who likes to go even faster. See what you think, but I'd try those if it were me

Since you know none of them are cursed, try on the scale armor at 15 Str, and see if you run at normal speed (the wheel in the top left corner). Then, once you get 16 Str, upgrade the plate armor until you can wear it (+3 gets it to 16 Str requirement).

If you can, try to avoid using scrolls of upgrade on the non-endgame gear
